messages:
incidents-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected on route: /v1/generate (eu-west) — 5xx spike, elevated latency. Paging oncall.

oncall-raj: reading it. seeing a lot of 502s from runtime-proxy to model-vpool-eu. Investigating.

emma-runtime: I can see repeated region failovers in the router logs — requests are bouncing eu-west -> eu-north -> eu-west in <10s windows.

lisa-policy: @emma-runtime can you paste the last routing decision trace? suspect policy change from last deploy.

emma-runtime: pastebin: https://paste.re/redwood/abcd — excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T17:01:10Z router: decision: route to eu-west variant v2-quant
2026-03-15T17:01:11Z router: failover -> eu-north variant v1-fp16 (incompatible kv cache)
2026-03-15T17:01:11Z runtime: kv-cache miss, model init
2026-03-15T17:01:12Z router: retry -> eu-west variant v2-quant
```

oncall-raj: that oscillation explains the latency. Why is router choosing incompatible variants across regions?

lisa-policy: earlier today we migrated the routing schema to remove deprecated field `prefer_variant` and rely on `variant_policy: auto` default. I think some team configs used the deprecated field; migration set them to `auto` which allows autonomous region-specific variant selection.

devops: that matches change log from the 16:40 deploy. rolling back sounds risky; can we patch route to an explicit variant pin quickly?

emma-runtime: yes, we can patch a policy override at the gateway level. quick mitigation: pin route to `variant: v2-quant` and set `fallback: disabled` for that application until we stabilize.

oncall-raj: do it. paste the exact curl you need and I'll run.

emma-runtime: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/internal/routes/patch -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_KEY" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","env":"prod","policy_override":{"variant":"v2-quant","fallback":"disabled"}}'

oncall-raj: running now.

deploy-bot: Command accepted. route patch queued.

oncall-raj: done — patch applied. monitoring.

sre-shift: graphs look better, 502s dropping to baseline within 30s. latency 95p back from 2.4s -> 200ms. nice.

customer-ops: any customer impact? seeing alerts from two major tenants in EU complaining about failed responses.

oncall-raj: preliminary: estimated 2.1% of EU production requests affected between 17:00-17:10 UTC, most returned 502/504. Flagging for incident report and customer outreach.

lisa-policy: root cause: schema migration removed implicit pin behavior for deployed customer configs using `prefer_variant`. Those configs defaulted to `variant_policy:auto` which allowed per-region selection of variants, and our region variant table had inconsistent available variants (v2-quant only in eu-west, v1-fp16 in eu-north). That mismatch plus our fallback policy attempted to retry across regions causing oscillation.

emma-runtime: long-term fix: migration script should have expanded `prefer_variant` into an explicit `variant` field or added `cross_region_compatibility: true` default. I'll open a PR to add a safe migration and stricter validator.

devops: immediate next steps logged: 1) update migration to backfill explicit variant pins for configs that had deprecated fields 2) add route-level validator to prevent cross-region incompatible variant set 3) postmortem + customer notifications draft.

oncall-raj: assigning owners: @emma-runtime for migration fix, @lisa-policy for policy validator and specs, @sre-shift for monitoring rule adjustments and replay tests.

customer-ops: I'll start drafting an email to the affected accounts with timeline + mitigation steps. ETA 30m. include rollback info and we should offer credits.

lisa-policy: adding a short-term guard in the control plane: reject `variant_policy:auto` for routes that reference model families not available in all regions; error instead of silently allowing.

emma-runtime: opened PR #4523 for migration backfill and PR #4524 for router validation. linking in ticket.

oncall-raj: thanks. I'll keep monitoring for 30 more minutes and then hand off to next shift. please update the incident doc with links.

sre-shift: noted. if oscillation resumes, set rate-limit on cross-region retries to 1 and escalate.

deploy-bot: rollback of 16:40 schema-deploy is scheduled as a fallback if fixes fail. standby.

oncall-raj: putting this in incident channel and tagging severity P2. Creating incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0315-02

customer-ops: emailed initial notification to affected customers. awaiting responses.

lisa-policy: postmortem owner assigned: lisa-policy. timeline entry required for the schema migration and the control-plane defaulting behavior.

oncall-raj: handing off to @sre-shift at 17:20 UTC. I'll be reachable if needed. :thumbsup:

 sre-shift: taking over. monitoring quiet. closing pager for oncall-raj. followups in INC doc.
